---
name: Bug report
about: Something does not work as the project documents it or as the original game does
title: 'bug: '
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

What breaks and where: file, command, map.

## Steps to Reproduce

Numbered commands and data a reviewer can run. If reproduction is unknown, write `Reproduction unknown` plus the conditions it was seen under (edition, map, action) — do not invent steps.

## Expected Behavior

What the repository documents or the original game does — link the note in `docs/` or the check that established it. An intentional difference from the original is not a bug: state the expected modern behavior.

## Actual Behavior

What was observed: output, error text, measured numbers with the conditions they were taken under.

## Environment

Only what matters: OS, Python or Rust toolchain, Tiled version, game edition the data came from.

Add `Evidence`, `Impact` or `Related Issues` only when they carry information.
